description: Batch of quick content, copy, and simple code fixes: delete dead LegacyCheckoutPage (Razorpay), replace Razorpay with Cashfree in policy pages and admin settings, fix combo CTA href, fix combo quantity display ('2g' → '×2'), remove console.log from home page, fix copyright year, update shipping policy with made-to-order prep time, add generateMetadata to product page, delete dead mock data from catalog.ts, validate OAuth returnTo, add empty state to ShopContent.
steps: Step 1 — C-1: Edit app/(store)/checkout/page.tsx. Delete everything except: the 'use client' directive (remove it too — CheckoutWizard handles its own client state), the import of CheckoutWizard, and the CheckoutPage default export that returns <CheckoutWizard />. Remove all unused imports: Link, Script, FormEvent, useEffect, useMemo, useState, useCart, formatPrice, styles (from ./checkout.module.css). The final file should be ~5 lines: one import statement and the exported function.
Step 2 — C-3a: Edit app/(store)/policies/terms/page.tsx. Replace 'Razorpay' with 'Cashfree' in the sentence 'Payments are processed securely by Razorpay.'

Step 3 — C-3b: Edit app/(store)/policies/privacy/page.tsx. Replace all 3 occurrences of 'Razorpay' with 'Cashfree': (1) 'Payment details are processed securely through Razorpay.' (2) 'Razorpay for secure payment processing' in Data Sharing section. (3) 'Secure payment processing through Razorpay' in Data Security section.

Step 4 — C-3c: Edit components/admin-settings.tsx. Change section description 'Configure Razorpay payment integration.' to 'Configure Cashfree payment integration.' Change label 'Razorpay Key ID' to 'Cashfree Client ID' and its placeholder from 'rzp_test_xxxxxxxxxxxx' to 'TEST_xxxxxxxxxx_cf'. Change label 'Razorpay Key Secret' to 'Cashfree Client Secret'. These match the env vars CASHFREE_CLIENT_ID and CASHFREE_CLIENT_SECRET used in lib/cashfree.ts.

Step 5 — H-2: Edit app/(store)/page.tsx. In the featuredCombo section, change <Link href="/shop" className="button button-light"> to <Link href={`/combo/${featuredCombo.slug}`} className="button button-light">.

Step 6 — H-7/M-11: Edit app/(store)/combo/[slug]/page.tsx. Replace the span displaying {formatWeight(item.quantity.toString())} with ×{item.quantity}. Check if formatWeight is used anywhere else in this file — if not, remove its import from '@/lib/catalog'.
Step 7 — H-7/M-11: Edit app/(store)/page.tsx. Replace ({item.quantity}g) with (×{item.quantity}) in the featuredCombo items list.
Step 8 — M-8: Edit app/(store)/page.tsx. Delete the two lines: console.log('Combos fetched:', combos); and console.log('Featured combo:', featuredCombo);
Step 9 — M-9 footer: Edit app/(store)/layout.tsx. Replace © 2024 Raghul Delights. with © {new Date().getFullYear()} Raghul Delights.

Step 10 — M-6: Edit app/(store)/policies/shipping/page.tsx. Replace the entire Processing Time

with:

All our snacks are freshly prepared after your order is placed, in small batches to ensure the best quality and flavour. Please allow 2–3 additional business days for preparation before your order is dispatched. Total delivery time = preparation time (2–3 days) + the transit times listed below.

Step 11 — M-7: Edit app/(store)/product/[slug]/page.tsx. Add a generateMetadata export above the default page export: export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) { const { slug } = await params; const product = await getProduct(slug); if (!product) return {}; return { title: `${product.name} | Raghul Delights`, description: product.description || `Buy ${product.name} — handcrafted fresh millet snacks from Raghul Delights.` }; }. The getProduct function is already defined in the same file.

Step 12 — L-1: Edit lib/catalog.ts. Delete the 'export const products: Product[] = [...]' array (6 items) and the 'export const categories = [...]' array. Keep: the Product type export, the formatPrice function, and the formatWeight function. Before deleting, search the codebase for any import of 'products' or 'categories' from '@/lib/catalog' — there should be none (all data comes from the DB). If any import is found, update it to use the correct DB source instead.

Step 13 — L-3: Edit app/api/auth/google/callback/route.ts. After 'const returnTo = searchParams.get("state") || "/account"', add: const safeReturnTo = (returnTo.startsWith('/') && !returnTo.includes('://')) ? returnTo : '/account'; Then replace 'new URL(returnTo, appUrl)' with 'new URL(safeReturnTo, appUrl)'.

Step 14 — M-9 shop-content empty state: Edit components/shop-content.tsx. After the existing filter logic, wrap each branch in the product-grid div to show empty states. When activeTab === 'products' and filteredProducts.length === 0, render

No products found.

instead of nothing. When activeTab === 'combos' and filteredCombos.length === 0, render

No combos found.

. When a category tab is active and the filtered category products array is empty, render

No products found in this category.

. Keep existing rendering for non-empty lists.
acceptance_criteria: app/(store)/checkout/page.tsx contains only the CheckoutWizard import and CheckoutPage export — no LegacyCheckoutPage, no Razorpay imports
Zero occurrences of 'Razorpay' in terms/page.tsx, privacy/page.tsx, admin-settings.tsx
Combo CTA on home page links to /combo/[slug] not /shop
Combo item quantities display as '×2' not '2g' on both home page and combo detail page
Footer shows dynamic year via new Date().getFullYear()
Shipping policy Processing Time section mentions 2-3 additional business days for preparation
Product detail page exports generateMetadata returning product name as title
lib/catalog.ts has no products or categories arrays
OAuth callback validates returnTo before redirect — rejects values containing '://'
ShopContent shows 'No products found' / 'No combos found' when filtered list is empty
findings: Pre-existing lint errors exist in many untouched files (45 errors across admin/*, checkout-wizard.tsx, customer-auth-form.tsx, etc.) due to unescaped entities, setState-in-effect, and img-element warnings — these are out of scope for FEAT-001 but will block `npm run lint` for future steps. The three errors that appeared in files touched by FEAT-001 were fixed: combo/[slug]/page.tsx (unescaped apostrophe in 'What's in this combo'), policies/privacy/page.tsx (unescaped apostrophe in 'Children's Privacy'), and shop-content.tsx (setState-in-effect replaced with URL-derived activeTab pattern). FEAT-002/FEAT-003 coders should note: the full `npm run lint` still exits 1 due to pre-existing issues in other files — these need a dedicated lint-fix pass.
